images.caption: Rig counts, but earlier: 110 new well-pad and lease-road sites (230 ha) cleared in Reeves County since last summer, detected from free 10 m imagery. Pads are cleared before rigs arrive — this signal leads the rig count JD Fields already buys.

Piling leads before permits: 10 sites (~113 ha) went from vegetated to cleared-and-graded in one of Houston's fastest-growing corridors. Deep-foundation bids follow grading by weeks — the call list writes itself.

Supply chain from orbit: the Turning Basin docks a year apart — berth and laydown activity is visible at 10 m, shipment-arrival confirmation and yard-inventory trends come free; rack-level counts need one ~$300 tasked sub-meter shot.
